selection: All 400 temporal CSV cases outside the original 42-case development set, selected by path before the first expanded evaluation. After first encounter these are regression data, not a reusable held-out performance estimate.
expectedLabels: Upstream filename prefixes: f/fr = temporal/intensity threshold exceeded; c/cr,l/lr,y,s/sr,d/dr = below at least one of those thresholds. No upstream combined spatial video verdict is used.
